Commentary.Commentary: ... THE RUN CHASE ...

200 looked far away at that time but Tanzim and Mahmudullah batted brilliantly. The two added just below the 100-run mark. Mahmudullah scored a fine half ton and Tanzim managed to cross the 40-run mark. The two though fell in quick succession but Islam struck a few meaty blows to take them close to the 230-run mark. West Indies still will fancy themselves to chase this down but Bangladesh will come out with fire. It's a must-win game for them but they'll need to make most of the new ball. Can they do so. We will find out. Join us in a bit for the second half.

After being inserted, Bangladesh kept losing wickets against the new ball. Seales was brilliant as he really got the new ball to talk and got three early on. The Bangladesh batters gifted their wickets after getting off to starts and at one stage, they were 115 for 7.

That's a fine effort with the ball from Windies but Bangladesh will also be quite pleased with how they have recovered. Yes, they'll know they are behind in the game but they have given themselves a chance thanks to Mahmudullah and Tanzim.

Commentary.Commentary: We're all set for the game to begin! Out walk the Bangladesh openers. The debutant Marquino Mindley to begin. Here we go...
Mehidy Hasan says it's the same wicket so there might be some turn. Adds they need to get a good score on the board. Mentions they have one change.

Shai Hope says there might be some moisture early on. Adds there is always something to learn. Mentions they could have been better with the ball at the start and more clinical with the bat. Informs they have one change.
Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tanzid Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Litton Das(WK), Mehidy Hasan(C), Afif Hossain, Mahmudullah, Jaker Ali, Rishad Hossain, Tanzim Hasan Sakib, Nahid Rana, Shoriful Islam.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King, Evin Lewis, Keacy Carty, Shai Hope(C)(WK), Sherfane Rutherford, Roston Chase, Romario Shepherd, Justin Greaves, Marquino Mindley, Gudakesh Motie, Jayden Seales.
TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and ELECTED TO BOWL!

Windies broke their drought against the Bangladesh side in the last game and would like to carry forward their momentum. We might not see them make any changes to their XI but we might see Bangladesh do so. Also, the toss might play an important factor. Stay tuned for it as it isn't far away.

A scintillating ton from Rutherford helped the hosts take a 1-0 lead in the series. Bangladesh though did have their moments but it was the Windies who won the crucial moments. It is now time for the second ODI and it is a must-win for the visitors if they want to stay alive in the series. The hosts, on the other hand, would look to seal it with a game to go. The venue is the same so we expect another high-scoring encounter. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.

The countdown is over at Warner Park in  St Kitts, where the latest chapter of the Bangladesh in West Indies, 3 ODI Series, 2024 is about to unfold as West Indies cross swords against Bangladesh in a match that is expected to be spectacular.
